trials.claim: Purchased Premium models never expire and can be edited and replaced at any time without limitations
trials.claimQuote: Purchased Premium models never expire and you can edit and replace them at any time w/o limitations
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only mention code-plan and storage limits; they do not address whether purchased Premium models expire or can be edited and replaced.

exhibits.quote: The deal does not really make sense to me on a 1 or 2 code plan.
exhibits.argument: This shows strict limits on number of models, contradicting the claim of editing and replacing without limitations.

exhibits.quote: ability to stack extra codes for more storage (up to 10) made scaling my projects straightforward and affordable.
exhibits.argument: This shows storage is limited and requires stacking extra paid codes, contradicting without limitations.

trials.claim: Lifetime hosting, embedding and AR viewing of purchased 3D models
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime hosting and embedding and AR viewing of your purchased 3D models
trials.reasoning: Reviews confirm models can be shared online and in AR and stored for future use, while the prosecution exhibits are feature requests that do not show hosting or AR viewing is unavailable.

exhibits.quote: however, it might be useful to make augmented reality available through markers, to reach some specific projects and older devices.
exhibits.argument: This shows AR viewing does not work for some projects and older devices, undermining lifetime AR viewing.

exhibits.quote: and add an option for augmented reality (and not have to manually add /ar/ to the link and generate the qrcode on another site).
exhibits.argument: This shows AR viewing and QR codes require manual workarounds and lack native support.

exhibits.quote: I love that I can share my 3D models online or in AR with just a few clicks.
exhibits.argument: This confirms online sharing and AR viewing work as promised for stored models.

exhibits.quote: I really like that I can store my models with p3d.in and use them in the future whenever I need them.
exhibits.argument: This confirms ongoing hosting and future reuse of stored models.

trials.claim: Max model size is 300 MB for purchased models and 100 MB for free models
trials.claimQuote: Max. Model Size: 300 MB for your purchased model, 100 MB for your free models
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about the 300 MB or 100 MB model-size limits.

trials.claim: Deal price is $59, regular price was $500
trials.claimQuote: Interactive 3D Experiences & Augmented Reality - no app install required: $59 (was $500)
trials.reasoning: Buying 10 codes for a larger plan does not disprove a $59 per-code deal price or a $500 regular price, and no exhibit verifies the $500 figure.

exhibits.quote: Just went for 10 codes to get the unlimited models premium plan!!
exhibits.argument: This shows buyers must purchase 10 codes for full plan, making the $59 single-code price misleading.

exhibits.quote: I purchased 10 codes. I'm not sure what I'll use these for completely--maybe NFTs?
exhibits.argument: This shows the real purchase is 10x the advertised $59 price to get usable capacity.

trials.claim: No app install required for interactive 3D and AR experiences

exhibits.quote: P3D.IN is a browser-based 3D model viewer for easy sharing.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the experience runs in the browser with no install required.
